<section aria-labelledby="courseDescription">
    Offered: Spring.

Prerequisite: GAME 4013.

Senior Game Project II is one of two capstone courses in the Game Design and Interactive Media Major. Students develop project-ready assets while working in an environment that simulates the "real world" experience of working in the game and interactive media field.
